request: Auto应按图片、视频、语音输出能力评分选模，语音支持生成MP3，避免文本模型反复规划代替媒体生成
acceptance: Image/video/speech candidates use separate explicit output capability weights and show scores, never infer generation from input vision
Native generation bypasses parallel planning, topic generation, compaction and blind repeat requests
Speech files preserve codec and support native MP3 on Qwen-Audio-TTS; existing WAV provider stays compatible
Video job ID persists before polling and recovery never silently creates duplicate billable jobs
Focused protocol/cancellation/routing tests and actual provider/browser acceptance recorded separately
TTS Tools exposes synthesis and system voices, MP3/WAV files, preserves default assistant TTS settings
scope: internal/server media/router/task adapters and adjacent tests
docs tasks/reviews and authorized existing release pipeline
New local aide-pkg-TTSTools plugin: explicit text-to-audio generation independent of assistant default TTS

requirements.summary: Add optional output modality profiles, exact adapter allowlist, distinct generation dispatch and bounded artifact persistence; retain legacy protocol and manual selection.
